home.title: Every life deserves to be remembered.
home.subtitle: Keep a life recorded, and let family and friends find it.
home.heroEyebrow: For every family, in every language
home.featuresTitle: A lasting place for the people you love
home.featureRememberDesc: Create a memorial page with their story, photographs, and the traditions that honour them.
home.featureFindDesc: Search by name to find someone remembered here, or share a link so others can visit.
home.featureShareDesc: Invite family and friends to contribute stories, leave tributes, and keep their memory alive.
home.ctaDesc: There is no deadline, no cost, and no account needed to visit. Creating a memorial takes a few minutes.
home.signUpPrompt: Sign in or create an account

auth.signInSubtitle: We will email you a six digit code.
auth.codeSubtitle: We sent a six digit code to {email}.

memorial.coCreateToggle: Create this memorial together with other family members
memorial.coCreateHelp: Co-creators share equal management rights. Enter their name and relationship to the deceased — when they register, we match them automatically. This avoids later disputes over managing the memorial or dividing offerings.
memorial.submitHint: Please select your relationship to the deceased and check all confirmation boxes.

memorial.noMessagesYet: No messages yet — be the first to leave one.
memorial.deleteConfirmQuestion: Delete this memorial? You have 30 days to restore it.
memorial.familyHelp: Connect your other memorials by relationship to build a family tree. The relationship you pick describes the other person relative to the person on this memorial (e.g. pick “Parent” if the other memorial is this person’s parent).
memorial.familyNoOthers: You have no other memorials to link yet.
memorial.myCreatedEmpty: You haven't created any memorials yet.
memorial.myBookmarkedEmpty: You haven't saved any memorials yet.
memorial.myRelatedEmpty: No memorials are shared with you yet.
memorial.myMentionsHint: These public memorials list you as a relative. Once your claim is confirmed, you formally join that family's tree.
memorial.claimError: Could not submit. Please try again.
memorial.recognitionReviewHint: Someone believes they are a relative of this person and has asked to join the family tree. Confirm or decline.
memorial.nameVisibilityHelp: Living relatives default to signed-in viewers only; anonymous visitors see a masked name. Choose Hidden to keep the name off the page entirely.
memorial.createdByNamed: This page is maintained by the {relation} of {name}

privacy.title: Who can see this memorial
privacy.publicHelp: Anyone can find and visit this memorial.
privacy.unlistedHelp: Not listed in search. Anyone holding the link can visit.
privacy.inviteOnlyHelp: Only people you invite can sign in and visit.
privacy.searchEngineLabel: Allow search engines to list this memorial
privacy.confirmPublicBody: The name, life story and photos will be visible to anyone, and search engines may list the page. You can change this later, but a search engine may keep an older copy for some time.
privacy.confirmPublicAcknowledge: I understand and want this memorial to be public.

religion.title: Faith and cultural tradition
religion.help: This only shapes what we suggest. Nothing is turned on until you choose it.

ritual.title: Ways visitors may remember them
ritual.help: Choose each one you want to offer. Nothing is offered unless you turn it on.

ritual.notRecommended: This is not usually offered in this tradition.
ritual.thanks: Thank you. It has been added to their page.
